conversations.title: I was abused after meeting man on dating app
conversations.reply: So sorry to hear that, it's just not right that you had to go through that. No one deserves to be treated like that, especially not on a platform that's meant to be about connection.

conversations.title: Designing tech for the people most often left behind
conversations.reply: It's great to see people talking about making tech work for everyone, not just those who are able-bodied. That's a conversation that's long overdue.

conversations.title: Friday briefing: How disabled creators are challenging an ableist world
conversations.reply: Love seeing disabled creators taking charge and challenging the status quo. It's amazing to see people using their platforms to make a difference.

conversations.title: Ways to recognize Disability Pride Month and practice inclusivity
conversations.reply: Disability Pride Month is a great time to reflect on how we can all be more inclusive. It's the little things that can make a big difference, like making sure venues are accessible.

conversations.title: Chicago summer in full swing this weekend with Fiesta Del Sol, WNBA All-Star Game, festivals
conversations.reply: Summer festivals are always a blast, hope you have a great time at Fiesta Del Sol and the WNBA All-Star Game, fingers crossed the venues are easy to get around.

conversations.title: Business rates cut for pubs, clubs and live music venues to boost high streets
conversations.reply: Cutting business rates for venues is a great way to boost high streets, but let's not forget to make sure these places are accessible to disabled people. Inclusive nightlife is just as important as affordable nightlife.

conversations.title: A Spectacular Arena is Set to Transform One of Britain’s Greatest Seaside Towns
conversations.reply: A new arena in Blackpool sounds like a great idea, but let's make sure it's built with accessibility in mind. That means step-free access, accessible seating, and facilities for disabled attendees.

conversations.title: Subhashree.Ayyappan
conversations.reply: Love seeing people like Subhashree.Ayyappan sharing their experiences and helping others find accessible venues. It's people like them that make a real difference.

target_reply: Hey Euan's Guide, love the work you're doing to make the world more accessible. Would be great to chat about how we can work together to promote inclusive venues and events, and make sure everyone can have a great time.
funding: Nothing new today, but UnLtd (unltd.org.uk) and Access to Work (gov.uk) are always worth checking out for funding opportunities.
moment: It's Disability Pride Month, and I'm celebrating by calling out ableism and promoting inclusivity wherever I go. Who's with me? Let's make some noise and demand equal access to opportunities and resources for all.
